text: {"lessons":["I should review risk and position sizes regularly; doing nothing through sharp declines left my account exposed to substantial losses.","Selling after steep falls was painful, but I should make decisions based on each stock’s outlook and portfolio risk—not simply wait for a price to recover or react to losses.","I should balance patience with clear, consistent rules for trimming or exiting positions, rather than letting loss aversion or the satisfaction of locking in gains dominate."]}
